sights.n: Kayauchi Banta cliff, Kunigami (茅打バンタ)
sights.w: A ~100 m sheer cliff and lookout near the island's northern tip, inside Yanbaru National Park; the name ('banta' = cliff) comes from the tale that a bundle of thatch thrown over the edge was torn apart by the wind.

sights.n: Senaga Island & Umikaji Terrace, Tomigusuku (瀬長島ウミカジテラス)
sights.w: A small island ~600 m off the southern west coast and 1.5 km south of Naha Airport, returned by the US military in 1977; since summer 2015 its slope is lined with the white, Mediterranean-style shops and cafés of Umikaji Terrace, with planes landing overhead and sunset views.

sights.n: Cape Kyan & the Peace Tower, Itoman (喜屋武岬)
sights.w: The south-western tip of the main island, 10–20 m cliffs where the Pacific meets the East China Sea; this coast saw the last desperate fighting of the Battle of Okinawa, and the 1969 Peace Tower memorial stands at the point, inside Okinawa Senseki Quasi-National Park.
